metadata.name: guard
metadata.description: Transaction Authorization Guard — Solana 2FA enforcement program

instructions.name: enforce
docs: The core integration point. External programs call this via CPI.
Reads proof data from the Instructions sysvar (ix[N-1] = record_proof,
ix[N-2] = secp256r1 precompile), verifies the P-256 signature, and
increments the registry nonce to prevent replay.
On success: emits an event with the policy name (visible in logs).
On failure: returns a specific error code.
Integration:
guard::cpi::enforce(cpi_ctx)?;  ← entire integration

accounts.name: registry
docs: Registry PDA — nonce is incremented on every successful verification.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The wallet whose registered passkey must authorize this action.

instructions.name: record_proof
docs: Pure data-carrier instruction. Carries WebAuthn proof data for
verify_via_sysvar to read from the Instructions sysvar.
This instruction itself does nothing except validate version == 1.
It must be placed at ix[N-1] immediately before the protected instruction.

instructions.name: register_two_fa
docs: Register a P-256 passkey in the caller's onchain registry PDA.
Idempotent — re-registering updates the key (recovery).
Charges register_fee on first registration, recovery_fee on re-registration.
The PDA (seeds: ["2fa", owner]) is the onchain source of truth.

accounts.name: config
docs: Global fee config — determines which fee to charge.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Receives the registration or recovery fee.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: One-time initialization of the global fee config PDA.
Called once by the Trana team after deployment.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Update registration/recovery fees or treasury address.
Requires the config authority to sign.

errors.name: MissingProof
errors.msg: Missing secp256r1 or record_proof instruction before the protected instruction

errors.name: PayloadMismatch
errors.msg: Intent hash does not match — transaction parameters were tampered

errors.name: WrongSigner
errors.msg: Proof was signed by a key not in the registry

errors.name: RegistryDisabled
errors.msg: Registry is disabled — register a passkey first

errors.name: PolicyMismatch
errors.msg: Proof policy does not match the expected trana standard policy

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not the config authority

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: Treasury account does not match config.treasury

types.name: ProofVerified
docs: Emitted on every successful proof verification.
Policy + target program are visible in on-chain transaction logs.
This is the zero-trust audit trail.

fields.name: owner
docs: The wallet that authorized the action.

fields.name: policy
docs: Application-defined policy that triggered enforcement (e.g. "transfer.large").

fields.name: target
docs: The program whose instruction was protected.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The nonce that was consumed (now invalid — cannot be replayed).

fields.name: expiry
docs: Unix timestamp when this proof expires.

types.name: TranaConfig
docs: Global fee configuration. Seeds: `[b"config"]`
Stores registration fees and the treasury destination.
Publicly readable — any auditor can verify exact fees without reading source.
Changes require a signed transaction from authority.

types.name: TwoFactorRegistry
docs: Per-user onchain 2FA registry.
Seeds: `[b"2fa", owner]`
`nonce` is incremented on every successful passkey proof verification —
old proofs cannot be replayed even if the signed intent was valid.
